correct_completion: I would learn to play the guitar.
full_sentence: If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
acceptable_variants: I would take up the guitar.
I could learn to play the guitar.

options.text: I learned to play the guitar yesterday.
options.why_wrong: The past simple describes a finished event and does not fit the unreal present condition set by 'had'.

options.text: I learn to play the guitar every day.
options.why_wrong: The present simple describes a real routine, but the 'if' clause is unreal, so the result needs 'would'.

options.text: I would learn to play the guitar.
I will learn to play the guitar since I have time.
options.why_wrong: 'Since' gives a real reason rather than an unreal condition, and 'will' does not match the unreal 'had'.

grammar_focus: Second conditional for unreal present situations
explanation: After 'if' with a past simple form, the main clause uses 'would' plus the base verb to show an unreal present situation.
translation: Gdybym miał więcej czasu, nauczyłbym się grać na gitarze.
